sum:

Supermarkets, cafés, and eateries are just a short walk away, while Manyata Tech Park, HRBR a quick drive. Covered parking included.
Please note: parties, gatherings and any illegal activities are strictly not allowed.

A refundable ₹5,000 deposit applies only for guests with no reviews or poor review history. It’s returned after checkout once everything is in order.
